newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle market near midday on Monday was quiet, with no reported sales, market sources said.

Activity was slow, with light bids at $108.00 per cwt on a dressed basis passed by owners pricing cattle at $111.00 to $112.00, they said. Bids on a live basis at $66.00 were passed with owners asking $69.00 to $70.00, sources said.
The bulk of last week's active sales were at $110.00, although there was a scratch top of $111.00 on Wednesday.
This week's state-wide showlist was estimated about the same as last week's estimated 77,000 head, sources said.
